sentences.text: Luoyanggia is a genus of oviraptorid dinosaur named after the city of Luoyang.
The type species of the genus is Luoyanggia liudianensis.
Holtz estimated Luoyanggia to be about 1.5 meters long and weigh between 2.27 and 9.1 kilograms. Molina-Pérez and Larramendi estimated the size of Luoyanggia to be 1.2 meters long and 8.5 kilograms.

Fossils of Luoyanggia come from the Early Cretaceous Haoling Formation in the Ruyang Basin of Henan Province, central China. Fieldwork and fossil assemblages indicate that the Haoling Formation dates to the Aptian-Albian stages. Luoyanggia lived between 121.4 and 100.5 million years ago during the Aptian to Albian stages.
